web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_1.author: LoveYourLife
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_1.text: Our twins love all the different vehicles and tasks. You can play on several devices, so there are no more fights over the phone: one of them can always play on the tablet.
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_2.author: Aunt Stacy M
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_2.text: My 4-year-old nephew loves this game. It’s one of the best car games for little ones! It’s very easy to play, and he loves choosing different cars and trucks. There’s even a car wash, and you can paint and draw on your car or truck. A great car game for kids aged 3 and up!
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_3.author: kimkim57
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_3.text: My granddaughter is 2. She plays this game really well and spends a lot of time on it. She’s so happy when she reaches the end of the obstacle course and gets her photo taken as a reward.
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_4.author: LostHero
web.lp_cars2.reviews.item_4.text: All kinds of vehicles in one place, and for good reason! Fun games, and you can even play without the internet, which is really handy on long trips.
